correctness.rationale: ETF trace gives c=2a and a(c-a)=3b. If a=0 then b=0 and all Gram products vanish although the four vectors span a nondegenerate Hermitian plane, impossible. In char ≠2,3, scale a to 1 using surjectivity of F_{q²} norm, hence b=1/3,c=2. A unitary map sends v0 to e1; torus phases normalize other first coordinates to µ with Nµ=1/3 and second coordinates to ρu_j with Nρ=2/3, u_j in T_q. Pairwise norms force (1+2t)(1+2t^-1)=3, equivalent to t²+t+1=0 and primitive cube root in cyclic T_q of size q+1; so q≡2 (mod3). Reverse construction with phases 1,ω,ω² verifies each pair overlap and sum v_iv_i*=2I. Boundary chars 2 and 3 explicitly excluded.
